owner.authority: Final authority over project operating policy.

auditor.authority: Owns governance verification, evidence integrity and the governance control machinery.
auditor.limit: Auditor ownership never grants authority to override an Owner decision.

ownership.note: Covers only the five documents named in Owner decision O-3. Every other path is governed by docs/ADDENDUM_A_EXECUTION_MASTER.md sections 3.1 and 3.2.
ownership.inference_rule: No additional governance owner is inferred or assigned without explicit Owner approval. A governance document with no named owner is reported as an ownership gap and left unassigned.

documents.auditor_controls: record integrity, status, history and governance consistency

layers.name: bootloader
layers.holds: where to look, in priority order

layers.name: policy
layers.holds: what the rules are, who owns them, how they change

layers.name: mechanism
layers.holds: what is actually enforced or reported, and by what

evidence_precedence.rule: Live evidence outranks stale documentation. When a document and the live system disagree, the live system is correct and the document is the finding.
evidence_precedence.l2_note: L2 compares L1's claims against L3 and reports the difference. It is never itself the source of truth about the system.

control_constraints.planted_defect_basis: GATE_REGISTER five rules, rule 2: a green result whose test could not have failed is rejected.

rules: When evidence shows the release condition is satisfied, the Auditor reconciles the hold immediately.
If the condition remains unresolved and requires Owner action, the hold remains explicitly OPEN or BLOCKED and is surfaced by governance health reporting.
Escalation is evidence and action based, never calendar based.
hold_model.primary_signal: A hold whose release condition is satisfied while the hold is still recorded as open.
hold_model.applies_to_gate_register_note: Applying this model to the standing-holds table in docs/gates/GATE_REGISTER.md is a separate Auditor act, not performed by this manifest.

amendment.basis: GATE_REGISTER five rules, rule 5: the original stands and the correction is filed beside it.
amendment.historical_document_convention: A historical document that no longer describes the repository carries a supersession banner at its top, and its body is left unchanged.
amendment.amendment_authority: An amendment is made by, or with the authority of, that document's owner in this manifest or in docs/ADDENDUM_A_EXECUTION_MASTER.md sections 3.1 and 3.2.

status_vocabulary.note: Reproduced for governance reporting. The authoritative definitions live in the documents named.

change_states.rule: These four are distinct and are never used interchangeably. A row reaches VERIFIED only on the Auditor's own instrument run.

staleness_policy.note: No max-staleness threshold has been decided by project governance. None is asserted here. Thresholds are to be added only by explicit Owner decision, never inferred.
